entry.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
entry.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

covers: Machine learning algorithms (classification, regression, clustering, dimensionality reduction)
Supervised and unsupervised learning with SciPy and ScikitLearn
Deep learning and neural networks with Keras, PyTorch, and TensorFlow
Large language models and generative AI
Natural language processing and text analytics
reading.format: 13-course series with hands-on labs and projects; learners build a portfolio of practical work.
reading.summary: This is a 13-course professional certificate that teaches AI engineering skills. It covers machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, large language models, and generative AI using Python and libraries such as Keras, PyTorch, and TensorFlow. Learners complete hands-on labs and projects to build a portfolio. Earning the certificate demonstrates practical experience and job-ready skills for AI engineering roles.
reading.audience: Data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, and other technical specialists who want to become job-ready as AI engineers.
